## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Get one WriteStack article by ID, including markdown body, publicationId, contentVersion, and Substack draft/schedule status. The markdown may include headings, bold/italic/strike/code, lists, blockquotes, :::pullquote, :::callout, and :::paywall. ALWAYS call this immediately before update_article and pass the returned contentVersion as baseVersion — the user may have edited the article in WriteStack since you last saw it.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `articleId` | `string` | Yes | WriteStack article ID |
